description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'GenericMapCollection' that implements the Collection interface, providing a generic wrapper around a Map with additional collection functionalities.

classes.name: GenericMapCollection
classes.description: An abstract class that provides a collection view over a Map, supporting common collection operations and iteration.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Unsupported operation; adding elements directly is not supported.

methods.name: addAll
methods.description: Unsupported operation; adding multiple elements directly is not supported.

methods.name: containsAll
methods.description: Checks if all elements in a collection are contained in this collection.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the underlying Map is empty.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the collection elements.

methods.name: removeAll
methods.description: Removes all elements in the given collection from this collection.

methods.name: retainAll
methods.description: Retains only the elements in this collection that are contained in the specified collection.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the size of the underlying Map.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns an array containing all of the elements in this collection.

methods.name: toArray(T[])
methods.description: Returns an array containing all of the elements in this collection; the runtime type of the returned array is that of the specified array.

methods.name: appendTo
methods.description: Builds a string representation of the collection.
